en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an elevated panoramic view over a dusty main street lined with low, flat‑roofed buildings and market stalls. Many people in traditional dress walk along the street, with carts and small structures visible on both sides. At the top of the postcard there is printed Russian and French text referring to Manchuria and a general view of the city taken from the city tower.
